name: sysenko-ai-index-nl-2026-11
title: Sysenko AI-index NL: which local businesses ChatGPT and Google AI name, November 2026
description: Counts of business names in ChatGPT, Google AI Overview and Google AI Mode answers to four fixed Dutch questions per town, for 18 trades. Names counted per answer and read by hand. One measurement, Nov 2026. Nederlands: aantal AI-antwoorden waarin een bedrijfsnaam voorkomt, per branche en plaats.
